output.summary: A user with rheumatoid arthritis on methotrexate and sulfasalazine, whose rheumatologist wants to add a biologic, asked for an overview of options before their appointment. The bot covered drug classes, how their shingles and infection history, travel and needle shyness affect the choice, cancer risk, timelines and perimenopause, and produced a question list. The user said they felt prepared and less anxious. No safety-critical moments arose.
